video-premiere-pro-ai-tools-48fn-pqiliy-.title: Premiere Pro For Beginners | 2025 Edition | Valentina Vee x Adobe Video
video-premiere-pro-ai-tools-48fn-pqiliy-.summary: Valentina Vee’s Premiere Pro for Beginners (2025 Edition) is a comprehensive, hands-on workshop that unfolds from project setup and file organization through detailed editing workflows, audio optimization with Adobe’s Essential Sound, color grading with Lumetri, captions, graphics, and music integration, to final export. The video emphasizes practical, tool-specific guidance rather than abstract concepts, including organizing assets on an external drive, creating and naming projects, managing bins and sequences, mastering core editing tools and keyboard shortcuts, using hover scrubbing, syncing multi-camera footage, applying auto-ducking and auto-match loudness, matching color across shots, building captions from transcripts, inserting graphics like lower thirds, and exporting with captions burned in. The instructor also demonstrates advanced techniques such as the Remix tool for music, Auto Reframe for social formats, multitrack multicam editing, adjustment layers for global color, and efficient workflow tips (ripple delete, slip/roll edits, and the use of an adjustment layer). The transcript reflects a project-based approach, including a vlog-style sequence and an interview with two camera angles, plus a detailed walk-through of asset management, sequencing, and export options, with downloadable assets and a companion PDF promised to learners.

video-premiere-pro-ai-tools-beh1i5n-798-.title: Premiere Pro Beginner Tutorial: End-to-End Video Editing in 2026 (Think Media)
video-premiere-pro-ai-tools-beh1i5n-798-.summary: Think Media’s complete beginner guide walks viewers through a full end-to-end workflow for editing a video in Adobe Premiere Pro (2026 era). The tutorial emphasizes upfront organization (A-roll, B-roll, assets), project setup and workspace configuration, media import into clearly named bins, creating and organizing a sequence, and performing core edits with keyboard shortcuts. It demonstrates overlaying B-roll on a multi-track timeline, applying speed changes for slow-motion on 60fps footage, and refining audio with a three-track mix, then adding titles, motion, and color correction via Lumetri and LUTs. The presenter also covers workflow efficiencies such as color-coding sections, editing the source footage to propagate color changes, white balance tweaks, and exporting with common presets. A sponsorship segment for Story Blocks is included, and the video provides downloadable project files for follow-along.

video-premiere-pro-ai-tools-pjobx9xqvgi-.title: Eight AI Tools in Premiere Pro: Remix, Extend, Transcription, and More
video-premiere-pro-ai-tools-pjobx9xqvgi-.summary: Justin Brown (Primal Video) demonstrates eight AI-powered features now available in Adobe Premiere Pro, highlighting how these tools speed editing and enable new workflows. The guide covers audio remix to extend or shorten music with automated seam blending, generative extend to lengthen video clips (up to a two-second AI-generated extension) and identify AI-generated portions, AI text-based editing through transcription (including language detection, speaker labeling, and editing from text), automatic captions export, enhanced speech for noisy audio, scene edit detection to insert cuts at shot changes, morph cut to smooth over jump cuts, AI reframing for auto-scene repositioning when changing aspect ratios, auto reframe sequencing for multi-clip projects, and AI-assisted color correction via Lumetri Auto with adjustable intensity. Throughout, the presenter notes practical caveats (e.g., 2-second extension limit, occasional perceptual differences in color correction, and verification of AI-generated edits). The video provides concrete steps and UI cues (e.g., locating Remix in the rate-stretch menu, selecting AI-generated regions, using Transcribe and the Lumetri Color tab) to help learners apply these features in real-world projects.

video-premiere-pro-ai-tools-xdq3ij-ohja-.title: Premiere Pro for Beginners: Project Setup, Timeline Editing, Color, Audio, Subtitles — Hands-on Walkthrough
video-premiere-pro-ai-tools-xdq3ij-ohja-.summary: This YouTube tutorial by Gavin Herman is a structured, beginner-focused Premiere Pro course. It guides viewers from setting up a project (folder structure, preferences, and performance choices) through creating a first edit, adding narration and sound design, performing basic color correction and grading with LUTs and Lumetri, adding captions, and applying motion graphics and keyframing. The video emphasizes real-world exercises, practical keyboard shortcuts, and iterative refinements (transitions, text, shapes, and audio). It also demonstrates an end-to-end export workflow and introduces techniques such as stabilization, nesting, and caption-to-graphics workflows, with occasional notes on AI-assisted subtitling and auto-transcription features.
